highlights: Fixed an incorrect qBittorrent version check that could block adding torrents on v5.2.4 in some environments (#2).
Preserved accurate torrent totals across page reloads, reducing repeated counting and wait times.
Refined mobile torrent detail views, configurable list columns, and navigation.
Improved source-backed qBittorrent Settings with safer saving and preservation of in-progress edits.
Enhanced RSS subscriptions and downloader controls while preserving navigation context.
Improved Logs with severity filtering, pagination, scrolling, and selectable text.

details.text: Improved installation and upgrade workflows across Windows, Linux, Docker, and NAS, including backup and rollback.
Reduced initial CSS and JavaScript requests through bounded bundles and lazy-loaded modules.
Improved large torrent libraries with smoother scrolling, paging, and neighboring-page prefetch.
Refined torrent detail panels, file priority actions, and resizable data tables.
Unified sorting, resizing, and column configuration across torrent tables.
Improved Add Torrent controls, dialogs, and operation feedback.
Separated live transfer rates from accumulated totals and improved status presentation.
Bounded WebAPI requests and improved recovery from stalled assets, polling, and route changes.
Polished responsive dialogs, selectors, and shared interaction controls.
